title: Auto-AEG: Scalable Data Construction for Open-Vocabulary Audio Event Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2607.04383v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) reason fluently about sound yet struggle to localize precisely when events occur, while classical Sound Event Detection (SED) attains frame-level precision only over a closed label set. At the intersection of these paradigms lies the task of Open-Vocabulary Audio Event Grounding: predicting all time intervals of a target sound event described by an arbitrary natural language query. Progress is bottlenecked by data scarcity: no large-scale resource provides open-vocabulary onset/offset supervision, and manual temporal annotation is prohibitively expensive. To address this, we introduce Auto-AEG, a scalable pipeline that constructs such supervision by automatic data construction and model fine-tuning. It pairs programmatically synthesized clips, which carry placement-exact ground-truth intervals for supervised cold-start, with multi-model pseudo-labels on real-world audio that supply the reward

translated_title: Auto-AEG：面向开放词汇音频事件定位的可扩展数据构建
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）能够流畅地对声音进行推理，却难以精确地定位事件发生的时间；而经典的声音事件检测（SED）虽然可以达到帧级精度，却仅限于封闭的标签集合。这两种范式的交汇之处便是开放词汇音频事件定位任务：预测由任意自然语言查询所描述的目标声音事件的全部时间区间。该任务的进展受制于数据稀缺：目前尚无大规模资源提供开放词汇的事件起止时间监督，而人工时间标注的成本又极其高昂。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Auto-AEG，一个通过自动数据构建与模型微调来生成此类监督信号的可扩展流水线。它将程序化合成的音频片段（带有位置精确的真值时间区间，用于监督式冷启动）与真实世界音频上由多模型生成的伪标签相结合，为强化学习提供奖励信号。
tldr: Auto-AEG提出了一条可扩展的自动化数据构建流水线，通过将带有精确真值时间区间的程序化合成音频与真实音频上的多模型伪标签相结合，为开放词汇音频事件定位任务生成大规模的起止时间监督数据，突破了该领域数据稀缺的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Auto-AEG presents a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs open-vocabulary onset/offset supervision for audio event grounding by pairing programmatically synthesized clips with placement-exact ground-truth intervals and multi-model pseudo-labels on real-world audio, addressing the critical data scarcity bottleneck.
